blocks.heading: Terms
blocks.text: Payment up front. Turnaround is usually one to two weeks and I will tell you if it will be longer. I will send a sketch before colouring, and revisions happen at that stage. Replace this with your own terms.

blocks.heading: What I will and will not draw
blocks.text: Original characters, fan art, and character portraits are commonly accepted work. NSFW content, extreme gore, and mecha or vehicle designs are commonly declined. Ask first about anything not listed here.

blocks.heading: How to order
blocks.text: Message me with what you want, which tier it is, and any references. I will confirm the price before you pay.
